note: Editorial and operating defaults (Step 01.3). An accepted item records accepted_on and accepted_by. Proposed items are not yet approved; open items have no value yet and are asked for at the step that needs them. Loaded into configuration at Step 03.

display_timezone.note: Stored in UTC; shown in IST

roles.note: One person may hold several roles. Confirm together with seeded users at Step 03

seeded_users.note: Ask the product owner at Step 03: names, emails and role assignments

recurring_opinion_threshold.note: Independent origin clusters before an opinion is described as recurring; not a fact check

freshness_warning_days.note: Console warns when the active revision is older than this and newer eligible evidence exists

withdrawal_serving_sla_minutes.note: From confirmed withdrawal to serving gate disabled and page revalidated

correction_owner.note: Ask the product owner before Step 11: named person who owns public correction requests

public_page_indexing.note: For the POC. Revisit before the page is used for SEO/AEO

demo_environment.note: Ask the product owner at Step 13: developer machine or shared VM for the Docker Compose demo

show_review_source_links.note: Review credit lines name the platform and date without a public link; links stay internal for moderators and withdrawal
